$schema-note: Adapter inputs for one corpus build. `corpus build --inputs <path>` reads this file. Every `inputPath` and `streetIndex` is relative to $MAILWOMAN_DATA_ROOT, resolved at launch.
$overlay-note: The sources this build rebuilds replace their v0.8.9-retention-overlay files in an overlay on that corpus. Each picks up the fixes since v0.8.9: the shared unit splitter (#2901), the augmentation sibling guards (d0b04a048, 38678ac0b), the record-id fixes (#2894), the aligner's exact-case binding (79314815b) and the component check (#2898). `geonames-features` is new (#2897). `ban` reads mainland France only: the v0.8.9 `ban` source held every row of RE, GP, MQ, GF and YT a second time beside `ban-re`, `ban-gp`, `ban-mq`, `ban-gf` and `ban-yt` (764,193 base rows), and those ten overseas sources are carried unchanged. `invented-house-venue` is carried unchanged because neither of its files records the tuples, seed or limit it was built from.
$street-index-note: Every adapter that splits a trailing unit reads the street index built from v0.8.9-retention-overlay's premise-register rows, so no row attests itself.
